translations.web: They rush on the city. They run on the wall. They climb up into the houses. They enter in at the windows like thieves.
translations.bsb: They storm the city; they run along the wall; they climb into houses, entering through windows like thieves.
translations.kjv: They shall run to and fro in the city; they shall run upon the wall, they shall climb up upon the houses; they shall enter in at the windows like a thief.
translations.asv: They leap upon the city; they run upon the wall; they climb up into the houses; they enter in at the windows like a thief.
